paper.title_en: Holographic Entanglement Entropy of Network CFT
paper.abstract_en: Miao et al. \cite{Guo:2025sbm, Guo:2026prm} proposed the AdS/NCFT correspondence, which explores the gravity dual of conformal field theories defined on networks. While previous studies investigated this model within Einstein and Gauss-Bonnet gravity (first- and second-order Lovelock gravity), in this paper, we generalize the framework to higher-order Lovelock gravity and more complex network structures. We derive the extremal and junction conditions for generalized Ryu-Takayanagi (RT) surfaces in third-order Lovelock gravity, which can be naturally extended to arbitrary higher-order Lovelock theories. Focusing on a network model comprising one node and three branches, we numerically investigate the relationship between the network holographic entanglement entropy (HEE) and gravitational coupling coefficients. Furthermore, by analyzing the HEE across various network configurations, we find that the primary structural feature affecting the network HEE is the presence of internal nodes within line-shaped networks. Our results indicate that the network HEE decreases as the number or depth of internal branches increases.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文将AdS/NCFT全息框架从Einstein与Gauss-Bonnet引力推广到三阶及任意高阶Lovelock引力，推导广义RT面的极值与交界条件，并数值分析网络全息纠缠熵与引力耦合系数的关系，属于高阶曲率修正引力方向，理论深度较好、方法路线清晰，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 网络共形场论的全息纠缠熵
decision.abstract_zh: Miao等人\cite{Guo:2025sbm, Guo:2026prm}提出了AdS/NCFT对应，探索了定义在网络上的共形场论的引力对偶。虽然此前研究已在Einstein引力和Gauss-Bonnet引力（一阶和二阶Lovelock引力）中考察了该模型，但在本文中，我们将该框架推广到高阶Lovelock引力以及更复杂的网络结构。我们推导了三阶Lovelock引力中广义Ryu-Takayanagi（RT）面的极值条件和交界条件，这些条件可以自然地推广到任意高阶Lovelock理论。聚焦于一个包含一个节点和三条分支的网络模型，我们数值研究了网络全息纠缠熵（HEE）与引力耦合系数之间的关系。此外，通过分析各种网络构型下的HEE，我们发现影响网络HEE的主要结构特征在于线形网络内部节点的存在。我们的结果表明，网络HEE随着内部分支数量或深度的增加而减小。
